newsitem.title: UK: SNOOKER-HENDRY ON COURSE FOR SEVENTH WORLD TITLE.
newsitem.headline: SNOOKER-HENDRY ON COURSE FOR SEVENTH WORLD TITLE.

text.p: Stephen Hendry stayed on course for a seventh world title by defeating fellow-Briton Darren Morgan 13-10 in the quarter-finals of the world snooker championship on Wednesday.
The world number one had trailed Morgan 5-3 before recovering to lead 9-7 overnight.
Welshman Morgan fought back to 9-9 on Wednesday before Hendry rallied for his 28th successive victory at the Crucible.
"I had a good run with the balls in the final session," said Hendry. "Darren was playing superbly and he potted some unbelievable balls.
Morgan said: "I honestly believed it was going to be my year. It will take somebody very good to beat Stephen."
